channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Quase 80% dos principais candidatos a governador não têm plano abrangente de saneamento, diz estudo
item.description: A study by Instituto Trata Brasil reveals that 49 out of the 62 leading gubernatorial candidates lack comprehensive sanitation plans. Only Pernambuco stood out, with both main candidates presenting complete proposals aligned with the Legal Framework for Sanitation.

item.title: De Pernambuco a Alagoas: veja onde eleição está acirrada e sem um favorito
item.description: The 2026 elections in eight Brazilian states, such as Acre and Alagoas, are expected to proceed to a runoff with tight races and no clear front-runners. Campaigns involve influential figures like Renan Filho and JHC, addressing issues like academic credentials and political alliances. Electoral tension reflects regional divisions and national alignments with the Lula government and Bolsonarism.

item.title: As estratégias de Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula no último dia antes do 1º turno
item.description: On Saturday (10/3), presidential candidates Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) hold their final campaign events before the first round of 2026, focusing on the Southeast region. Lula ends with a walk on Paulista Avenue, while Flávio closes his campaign in Rio de Janeiro, his political birthplace. São Paulo is a priority for both, though polls show Tarcísio leading Haddad in the gubernatorial race.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: as pesquisas que serão divulgadas na véspera do 1º turno
item.description: Polls released on the eve of the 2026 first round indicate a technical tie between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). Over 158 million voters are eligible to choose among 12 presidential candidates.

item.title: Eleições 2026: veja o que pode e o que não pode antes do primeiro turno
item.description: The 2026 elections' first round takes place on October 4th, with rules set by the TSE. Campaign activities such as walks and parades are allowed until 10 PM, while loudspeakers must keep a minimum distance from sensitive locations. Northern and Northeastern states implement an electoral dry law.

item.title: Falso brilhante
item.description: The text compares the trajectories of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro with that of Fernando Collor de Mello in 1989, highlighting concerns about lack of political content, questionable funding, and electoral manipulation. It warns about the risks of empty or strategically misleading candidacies to address national crises.

item.title: Grupo do Brasil inspirado em atos Gen Z no Nepal conspira antes de eleições
item.description: A Brazilian group inspired by the Gen Z protests in Nepal is planning actions ahead of the 2026 elections, according to monitoring by Telegram groups. The movement, marked by criticism of corruption and political instability, was previously targeted by police operations. Despite a setback after arrests in 2025, new discussions about mobilizations have emerged recently.

item.title: Veja a agenda dos candidatos ao governo de SP neste sábado (3/10)
item.description: On Saturday (10/3), the São Paulo gubernatorial candidates carry out their final campaign events ahead of the first round on Sunday. Frontrunners Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Fernando Haddad (PT) have busy schedules, while the remaining candidates hold varied activities or do not publish official itineraries.

item.title: Chamada de “pilantra” por Lula, Luchsinger doou R$ 50 mil para evento do PT
item.description: Lobbiast Roberta Luchsinger donated R$50,000 to the PT through a fundraising dinner in March 2024, using third-party accounts to avoid records. President Lula called her a 'swindler' after discovering the donation. The operation involved Swedenberger Barbosa (Berger), former #2 at the Ministry of Health and current deputy chief of staff to the President.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: entenda o que diz o texto e a regra de transição; proposta pode ser votada no Senado na próxima semana
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre scheduled a session to discuss the PEC ending the 6x1 scale, which will reduce the weekly work hours from 44 to 40. The proposal, a key Lula campaign pledge, requires two Senate votes and will be phased in after enactment.

item.title: Huawei aposta em loja física e ecossistema de produtos para disputar o mercado de smartphones no Brasil
item.description: Huawei has opened its first official authorized store in São Paulo, marking the beginning of a new phase of physical expansion in Brazil, after resuming its presence in the smartphone market with a focus on wearable devices and audio ecosystems. The strategy aims to compete directly with Samsung, Apple and Motorola, especially in the premium segment, using smartwatches and earphones as a gateway for consumers. After leaving the domestic retail market in 2019 due to U.S. sanctions, the company is now seeking to reaffirm its brand in the country with an innovation and device integration proposal.

item.title: A conversa da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro com um ministro do STF indicado por Lula
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho, campaign coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro, met with Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin, appointed by Lula. The meeting is part of a dialogue strategy with the court.

item.title: Sprint final: Lula e Flávio apostam em críticas ao Judiciário, 'voto útil' e eleitorado estratégico na véspera do pleito
item.description: Lula and Flávio step up attacks on the judiciary and seek to amplify rejection of their opponent on the eve of the first round, with strategies aimed at specific voter segments amid an unprecedented institutional crisis.

item.title: Proibidos pelo TSE após Marçal, campeonatos de cortes nas redes seguem impulsionando campanhas de candidatos nas redes
item.description: The TSE banned social media cut competitions following the ineligibility of Pablo Marçal, but the practice continues to be used by candidates like Sargento Nantes, who is running for the Chamber of Deputies. The strategy involves editors creating dynamic short clips to gain views and payments. Nantes' campaign was organized through the Clipei platform, linked to former Marçal employees, and remained active despite the ban.

item.title: Atividades consulares dos EUA foram suspensas por 'segurança' pela primeira vez no Brasil desde o 11 de Setembro
item.description: The United States and Australia temporarily suspended their consular activities in Brazil for 'security reasons' on the eve of the first round of elections. The measure, which lacked specific threat details, was exceptional, last occurring after September 11. Experts suggest the decision reflects concerns about stability and may affect Brazil's international image.

item.title: Voto nos estados: Caiado deixa voo presidencial de lado na reta final para focar em eleger sucesso e esposa em Goiás
item.description: In the final stretch of the first round, Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) shifted focus to Goiás, canceling his national agenda after the Globo debate was called off. He reinforced local mobilization with Daniel Vilela (MDB) and Gracinha Caiado (União), emphasizing support for reelection and the environmental ticket.

item.title: Mapa da campanha: Tarcísio ampliou presença na Região Metropolitana, enquanto Haddad tentou conquistar interior
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad were present in 46 of the 645 municipalities in São Paulo state during the first 40 days of campaigning, focusing on the capital and prioritizing different interior regions. Tarcísio expanded his presence in the Metropolitan Region, attempting to attract traditionally left-leaning voters, while Haddad visited areas that voted more right-wing, such as Ribeirão Preto and Marília, facing challenges in mobilizing support in the interior. Both are adjusting their campaign strategies to appeal to dissenting voters ahead of the competitive 2026 gubernatorial race in São Paulo.

item.title: Artigo: 'O peso da abstenção nas pesquisas', escreve Felipe Nunes, diretor da Quaest
item.description: Felipe Nunes emphasizes rising voter abstention in Brazil, challenging poll accuracy. He notes Quaest will use a 'likely voter model' to adjust valid vote estimates, incorporating variables like civic duty, social pressure, and perceived competitiveness. Lula’s 2022 performance exemplifies how abstention in certain demographics can skew outcomes.

item.title: Rali: Lula aparece à frente de Flávio Bolsonaro em cenários de 1º e 2º turnos no agregador de pesquisas do GLOBO
item.description: The Rali poll aggregator shows Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in both hypothetical first and second rounds of the 2026 election. In the first round, Lula has 40.3% of voting intentions against 36.9% for Flávio; in a second-round scenario, Lula reaches 46.7% versus 45.1% for Flávio. The tool also indicates 46.8% approval of President Lula’s administration among surveyed voters.

item.title: Governo brasileiro vê sinais trocados de Trump às vésperas do primeiro turno em meio a receio de interferência externa
item.description: The Brazilian government has detected signs of foreign interference from the United States ahead of the first round of elections, including tariffs and the designation of criminal factions as terrorist groups. Despite moments of rapprochement between Trump and Lula, the federal government is investigating alleged actions by Bolsonaro family members to destabilize Brazilian democracy.

item.title: Como a engenharia do segundo voto embola a disputa pelo Senado em eleições como as do Rio, Minas e DF
item.description: The 2026 Senate race is marked by strong polarization and the complexity of second-round voting, especially in Rio de Janeiro and Minas Gerais. Candidates from the same ideological camp struggle to transfer votes, fragmenting the electorate and making the election unpredictable.

item.title: Jogo político: Em seis pontos, o que será decisivo na mais imprevisível eleição de todos os tempos
item.description: Polls indicate the narrowest gap between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round in history, intensifying the presidential race. In São Paulo, Tarcísio de Freitas is expected to win over Haddad, while in Rio de Janeiro the contest could conclude in the first round following the annulment of Garotinho's valid votes. Experts warn of a possible rise in non-voting due to voter disengagement and 31% undecided respondents.

item.title: Garotinho: entenda o que dizem a regra das eleições e a decisão mais recente do TSE sobre contagem ou não de votos
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) suspended campaign funding for Garotinho and kept his candidacy unapproved, following action by Eduardo Paes's campaign. Garotinho's votes will be counted as 'anulled sub judice' according to TSE rules, though they are not considered valid for any purpose. The decision creates uncertainty regarding the possibility of a first-round election in Rio.

item.title: Ele vota em um candidato, ela em outro: como a política pode afetar o relacionamento
item.description: A Hibou survey reveals that 67% of Brazilians voted for different candidates than their partners, yet 85% view voting as an individual decision. Experts note that political disagreements in established relationships require dialogue about values, while for singles, opposing views may affect the start of a romance.

item.title: TSE recebe convidados internacionais para apresentar sistema eleitoral
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) held a seminar to welcome international guests and present Brazil's electoral system, emphasizing voter protagonism and challenges such as misinformation and political gender-based violence. Judge Renata Gil emphasized the role of Electoral Justice in ensuring freedom, security, and equality in voting, along with advances in technology, accessibility, and mitigation of climate impacts for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Decisão será fácil porque eleitor sabe onde o calo aperta
item.description: The 2026 election is marked by voter fatigue, frustration, and the Supreme Court's decisions taking precedence over concrete proposals. The race is seen as dry and lacking substantive debate, with emphasis on judicialization.

item.title: Lula pede que TSE investigue suspensão de serviços de embaixadas dos EUA
item.description: Lula's campaign asked the TSE to investigate the suspension of U.S. consular services in Brazil as potential foreign interference in the elections. The move aims to prevent foreign influence in the electoral process.

item.title: Brasileirão: Cuca exalta melhora do elenco e comemora campanha no 2º turno
item.description: Cuca praised the tactical improvement of the Santos squad after their 2-1 victory in the San-São derby, celebrating the strong performance in the second half of the Brazilian Championship with 20 points earned. The coach highlighted new signings and collective performance, noting the team is tied for the lead with Flamengo. He also mentioned the possibility of Neymar playing in the upcoming match against Flamengo.

item.title: Conselho pede monitoramento da liberdade religiosa nas eleições
item.description: The CNDH requested the IACHR and the Special Rapporteur for Freedom of Expression to monitor potential risks to religious and expression freedoms during the 2026 elections, citing cases such as the fake news involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Our Lady of Aparecida. The goal is to track hostility against religious individuals and institutions, judicial decisions on content removal, and their impact on religious participation in public debate.

item.title: TSE usa critérios diferentes para julgar comerciais de Lula e Flávio
item.description: The TSE, through Minister Estela Aranha, applied different criteria when judging communications involving Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. In one case, Flávio requested the removal of Lula's statements about militia members, but the minister ruled that no specific criminal facts were described. In another case, the PL was sanctioned for misleading advertising linking Lula to former congressman Uldurico Junior, being ordered to remove the content under fine.

item.title: Quem são todos os candidatos a senador por Minas Gerais (MG) nas eleições de 2026
item.description: Seventeen politicians compete for two Senate seats in Minas Gerais in the 2026 elections, with candidates from various parties including Carlos Viana (PSD), Aécio Neves (PSDB), and Marília Campos (PT). The race is wide open with no runoff for senators.

item.title: Lula liga Flávio a Vorcaro e milícias em última propaganda
item.description: In his final campaign ad before the first round, Lula used a video narrated by Chico Pinheiro to attack Flávio Bolsonaro, highlighting his ties to Daniel Vorcaro, militia figure Adriano da Nóbrega, and the 'rachadinha' scandal. The ad also reused controversial quotes from Jair Bolsonaro, including comments about Venezuelan teenagers, reinforcing efforts to discredit the opponent.

item.title: Sem citar Lula, Anitta diz em vídeo que vota em quem é contra as bets
item.description: Anitta stated, without mentioning Lula, that she supports banning betting platforms and encourages voting for candidates against bets. She also advocated for ending the 6x1 work schedule and greater female participation in politics. Her statement follows the release of the provisional measure banning bets in Brazil.

item.title: A dois dias da eleição, Flávio ganha reforço de Nikolas durante 'bloquinho' em MG com dança, oração e ataques a Janja
item.description: Two days before the 2026 election, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) held a campaign rally in Montes Claros, MG, featuring dances, prayers, and attacks on the PT and First Lady Janja. The event, marked by chants and strong symbolism, underscored their alliance and forecast a first-round victory.

item.title: Em ato em MG antes do 1º turno, Flávio promete "virar triste página" do PT
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro pledged in Montes Claros to turn the page on the PT era and claimed Brazil will have a new president on Monday after the election. He emphasized dedication to his potential mandate and criticized PT management.

item.title: Defesa de deputados do PT acusa Flávio de tentar escolher relator no STF
item.description: The defense team of federal deputies Lindbergh Farias and Rogério Correia, from the PT party, rejected the accusation filed by Flávio Bolsonaro at the STF, claiming the senator is attempting to influence the appointment of the judge in the case, bypassing distribution rules. The lawyers requested the dismissal of the crime report and argued that parliamentary activity does not constitute a crime.

item.title: Campanha de Lula convoca “milhões de Lulas” para mobilização
item.description: The Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva campaign issued a statement signed by campaign manager Edinho Silva, urging party directors, committees, and brigades to intensify grassroots mobilization in the 48 hours before the first round of the 2026 elections, emphasizing door-to-door outreach, street leafleting, and walking tours. The appeal targets "millions of Lulas," reinforcing a strategy of popular engagement.

item.title: Democracia brasileira não vai aguentar muitas eleições realizadas dessa maneira, diz cientista político
item.description: Political scientist Leo Barreto warns that the increasing judicialization of electoral campaigns threatens the stability of Brazilian democracy. He criticizes delays in resolving legal disputes and strategies to direct cases to specific rapporteurs, which creates mistrust among voters and weakens the democratic process.

item.title: Empresas fazem protesto no MorumBis em 1° jogo após MP das bets
item.description: Following the publication of the provisional measure banning sports betting in Brazil, companies and clubs have reacted with protests and legal actions. In the first game after the MP, Morumbis displayed messages against the ban, while clubs requested a grace period from the Supreme Court. The measure impacts billions in football sponsorship revenues.

item.title: As pesquisas e o momento crítico da disputa entre Lula e Flávio na eleição presidencial
item.description: The final stretch of the presidential race between Lula and Flávio shows a tight contest with significant variations across major electoral colleges. Surveys indicate that some voters are still deciding their vote, which could influence the outcome. Political scientists emphasize the importance of undecided voters at this critical moment.

item.title: Veja como foi a sexta-feira (2) dos candidatos a presidente
item.description: On the eve of the first round of the 2026 elections, presidential candidates held walks, rallies, and events in various cities, emphasizing voter outreach and criticism of judicial interference. Lula encouraged senior voting and defended investments in education and science; Flávio Bolsonaro campaigned in Minas Gerais; Augusto Cury criticized judicial decisions and proposed a pact among powers. Other candidates held interviews, campaign closing events, and voter convergence events across different states.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula aposta em mini-documentário contra Flávio
item.description: Lula's campaign released a nearly seven-minute mini-documentary on social media accusing Flávio Bolsonaro of involvement in alleged crimes and scandals, two days before the election. The content compiles criticisms of the PL senator's political trajectory.

item.title: Datafolha em SP, MG, RJ, PE e DF: margem de Lula supera 2 milhões de votos
item.description: Datafolha released a presidential poll in five states (SP, MG, RJ, PE, and DF), showing Lula (PT) leading Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) by over 2 million votes (29.9M vs. 27.8M). While caveats like margin of error and abstention remain, the current trend favors the PT candidate.

item.title: MP da Bets: setor de apostas anuncia protestos durante jogos do Brasileirão
item.description: The federal government banned online betting through Provisional Measure 1.394/2026, signed by President Lula on September 25. In protest, ANJL and IBJR announced actions during Brazilian Championship games, claiming the ban strengthens the illegal market and exposes bettors to scams. The Ministry of Justice reported 88,000 illegal betting sites identified, but emphasized the need for regulation to curb organized crime growth.

item.title: Lula cobra Senado por fim da escala 6 X 1: “Brasil precisa fazer”
item.description: President Lula urged the Senate to advance the vote on the PEC ending the 6 X 1 work schedule, emphasizing the government's priority and praising Senate President Davi Alcolumbre's support. The proposal is expected to be discussed next week, though voting is unlikely due to procedural requirements and opposition. Lula stressed the need to improve Brazilian workers' conditions.

item.title: Quem são todos os candidatos a presidente da República do Brasil nas eleições 2026
item.description: Twelve candidates run for president in 2026, including Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The race is marked by polarization and competing political legacies. The first round takes place on October 4th.

item.title: Fachin manda inquérito que apura existência de gabinete do ódio de Raquel Lyra ao STJ
item.description: The president of the Supreme Federal Court, Edson Fachin, forwarded an investigation to the Superior Court of Justice regarding an alleged ' hate cabinet' linked to the governor of Pernambuco, Raquel Lyra. The probe aims to verify the existence of a structured group for political defamation and disinformation.

item.title: Lula ou Flávio? Quem saiu mais prejudicado após cancelamento de debate da Globo
item.description: The cancellation of the Globo debate harmed President Lula more, according to political scientist Leo Barreto, as it particularly affects undecided voters in the final stretch of the campaign. Flávio Bolsonaro tried to frame the incident as censorship, but both candidates were negatively impacted. The debate was a key opportunity to reach undecided voters.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro em MG: "Poucas horas pra tirar o Brasil do cativeiro"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) spoke in Montes Claros (MG), claiming only hours remain to 'free Brazil from captivity'. At a 'Blocão 22' event, he emphasized Minas Gerais' strategic weight as the second-largest electorate. A Datafolha poll released the same day showed Lula leading with 42% versus 36% for Bolsonaro in the state.

item.title: Renan Santos desafia Flávio a debate em troca de apoio no 1º turno
item.description: Renan Santos challenges Flávio Bolsonaro to a direct debate, offering first-round support if he loses. He criticizes the opponent's lack of proposals and focuses the proposal on ideas, without addressing scandals. The challenge occurs after the cancellation of a debate by Globo due to court decisions.
